response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT st.riskeval AS grp, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY st.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench

assumptions.assumption: A site with a NULL riskeval forms its own group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together). Empty-string or other values are treated as ordinary statuses.

A scan's ratio counts as missing when gbsize or spanmin is NULL, or when spanmin is 0 (division undefined). Such scans are excluded. A group left with no valid ratios has no rate and doesn't count toward the benchmark.
If no group is strictly above the benchmark (for example, with one group or none), the query returns one row with NULL values.
